# deploy.sgit.ai — sgit deployment docs, served from an encrypted vault
# (also reachable as sgit-ai.github.io/SGit-AI__API until DNS lands)

> This host is the deployment-documentation site for sgit's server side (the SGit API):
> a pure static projection of an encrypted vault — ciphertext at the live API's read
> paths plus one HTML page that decrypts and renders the docs in the browser. There is
> no server, no auth, and nothing but GETs. The host holds only ciphertext. Everything
> here (apart from the vault write key, which never enters the repo) is public and open
> source: https://github.com/SGit-AI/SGit-AI__API (branch `dev`, Apache-2.0).

The plaintext of every document served here is committed in that repository under
`vault/` — agents without a JS runtime should read the markdown there:

- vault/00-START-HERE.md — deploy hub: targets, runbooks, reference
- vault/run-your-own-server/README.md — why + choose your path
- vault/deploy/{docker,aws-lambda,aws-ec2,aws-fargate,gcp-cloud-run,heroku,static-hosting}/README.md
- vault/runbooks/{new-aws-account,new-region}/README.md
- vault/reference/{configuration,storage-modes,security-model}.md
- vault/scripts/README.md
- vault/docs/status.md — THE REFACTORING, LIVE: current status of the SGit API extraction
- vault/docs/{what-is-the-sgit-api,read-contract,static-hosting,roadmap}.md — the API itself
- vault/MAINTENANCE.md — how these docs are maintained (docs move with code, publish = sgit push)

Provenance: the deploy guides were republished 2026-08-18 from the SG/Send team's vault
`fyofmkvr` (commit obj-cas-imm-000f0325258c) — the live source behind sgit.ai/deploy
until the handover completes. They are maintained here from now on, in the same commits
as the deployment code they describe.

## Reading the vault from this host (no repository needed)

Read key (published deliberately; grants read only):
  c28b118c9a7a101910efa24a3a49b6cc6dbec8e8dcdc8fea671e89cecb0ab817
Vault id: ivpijuvg

The walk — every step a plain GET of a computed path:
  ref file id = 'ref-pid-muw-' + hex(HMAC-SHA256(read_key, 'sg-vault-v1:file-id:ref:ivpijuvg'))[:12]
  GET <this-origin>/api/vault/read/ivpijuvg/bare/refs/<ref-id>  -> AES-256-GCM(iv||ct), JSON {commit_id}
  GET .../bare/data/<commit-id>                                 -> commit {tree_id, parents, message_enc}
  GET .../bare/data/<tree-id>                                   -> tree {entries: [{blob_id, tree_id, name_enc, ...}]}
  GET .../bare/data/<blob-id>                                   -> a file's ciphertext
  all decryption with the read key; *_enc metadata fields are base64(iv||ct) of UTF-8.
A reference implementation in ~90 lines is served here as /reader.js
(browser WebCrypto and Node >= 19; on the github.io origin, prefix paths with /SGit-AI__API/).

## Known gap (pinned in CI)

The sgit CLI's `clone` cannot yet read from this host — it depends on the live API's
batch endpoint (POST /api/vault/batch/...). A proposal for GET-only static clone (which
would also make a local folder a valid remote) is filed in the repository at
team/comms/briefs/08/17/v0.1.2__proposal-brief__static-clone-a-get-is-open-a-file-and-a-folder-is-a-remote.md.
Writes and authentication are absent by design: this is a published, read-only snapshot
and the ciphertext is the protection.
